What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Digital commerce automation using Google Apps Script is a paradigm shift for creators in underserved markets. Unlike conventional platforms that impose restrictions and fees, this approach empowers creators with full ownership of their payment processing and product delivery. By leveraging a combination of Google Apps Script for backend logic and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification, creators can achieve instant order fulfillment. This not only enhances efficiency but also ensures that creators have complete control over their sales processes, eliminating reliance on external platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture relies on several key components: Google Apps Script handles backend logic for order processing, while NOWPayments facilitates the automatic processing of crypto transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the webhook from NOWPayments triggers Google Apps Script, which then manages the order fulfillment process. The integration with Supabase or Google Sheets allows for seamless storage of order data, enabling quick access and retrieval for processing. This entire setup is designed to operate efficiently, capable of handling up to 100,000 webhook events per day through Cloudflare Workers, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment methods are inaccessible. Creators selling ebooks, courses, and other digital products in countries like Ghana, Kenya, and Zimbabwe can benefit from this architecture. It provides them with a reliable way to collect payments in cryptocurrency, fulfilling orders automatically without the need for traditional banking structures. By removing barriers to entry, this framework allows creators to focus on their craft while maintaining a sustainable revenue stream.
Empower your digital commerce with complete ownership and control.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful operation of this automation system hinges on several integrated components. Google Apps Script serves as the backend engine, executing logic based on payment confirmations from NOWPayments. Cloudflare Workers facilitate the webhook event handling, ensuring quick responses to payment events. Supabase or Google Sheets provides a robust database for order storage, while delivery of digital products is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Each component works in harmony to create a seamless and efficient digital commerce experience for creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To leverage this automation architecture, start by deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, which can be set up in just 48 hours. Configure your Google Apps Script to handle order processing and integrate NOWPayments for payment verification. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets to maintain an organized database. Set up your digital product delivery through Google Drive, ensuring that your customers receive their products automatically post-purchase. By following these steps, you can establish a fully operational digital store with minimal hassle.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by integrating payment processing with backend logic. When a customer pays, NOWPayments sends a webhook to Google Apps Script, which processes the order and triggers product delivery. This ensures that download links or products are sent instantly after payment confirmation, creating a seamless experience for the customer.
Achieve instant order fulfillment with a sovereign architecture.

Creators researching automated webhook delivery and crypto payment fulfillment pipelines are often moving from manual order processing to a system that operates without constant attention. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 includes the complete automated pipeline: NOWPayments webhook handling in Cloudflare Workers, order logging to Supabase, and delivery email via Resend — all configured, tested, and running under your accounts before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete technical implementation for both Stack 01 and Stack 02. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery involves using a webhook from NOWPayments to trigger Google Apps Script upon payment confirmation. This process ensures that the product is automatically delivered to the customer immediately after the transaction is verified.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a mechanism that allows one application to send real-time data to another when a specific event occurs. In this context, it triggers order fulfillment by notifying Google Apps Script to process the order once payment is confirmed.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, by integrating NOWPayments with Google Apps Script, you can automatically send download links to customers as soon as their crypto payment is confirmed, streamlining the post-purchase experience.
What are the benefits of using Google Apps Script in this architecture?

Google Apps Script provides a flexible backend solution for automating order processing, enabling creators to customize their logic without needing extensive programming knowledge while ensuring fast response times.
How does Cloudflare Workers enhance this setup?

Cloudflare Workers enhance this setup by efficiently managing webhook events, allowing the infrastructure to handle up to 100,000 events per day on the free tier, ensuring scalability and reliability for high transaction volumes.
